      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "from sklearn. linear_model import LinearRegression\n",
        "from sklearn. metrics import mean_squared_error,r2_score"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "JCYXjeOModT0"
      },
      "execution_count": 66,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## *(1) Data loading & Exploration  "
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "YThxmOy2qcbI"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": 67,
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "Yhgb7DC4mhsP",
        "outputId": "a11e6191-566c-4bb8-c01f-aa3e1fc171e3"
      },
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "---first 5 rows---\n",
            "   Student_ID Study_Hours  Attendance_Rate  Exam_Score\n",

            "2         103           2             60.0          48\n",

      ],
      "source": [
        "# قراءه ملف البيانات\n",
        "df=pd.read_excel('/content/Student_scores.csv.xlsx')\n",
        "\n",
        "#عرض اول   5صفوف\n",
        "print('---first 5 rows---')\n",
        "print(df.head())\n",
        "\n",
        "#عرض معلومات عن الاعمده والقيم المفقوده\n",
        "print('---Initial Data Summary---')\n",
        "print(df.info())\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "##*(2) Data cleaning [duplicates,missing value,outliers]\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "IMBbgCTytaon"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "#الصفوف المكرره قبل الحذف\n",
        "print('---Duplicate rows before deletion---')\n",
        "print(df[df.duplicated()])\n",
        "#مسح الصفوف المكرره\n",
        "df=df.drop_duplicates()\n",
        "#  اتاكد ان المكرر اتحذف المفروض تطلع 0\n",
        "print('---Duplicate rows after deletion---')\n",
        "print(df.duplicated().sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "print('='*20)\n",
        "# عرض عدد القيم الفارغه قبل الحذف\n",
        "print('---Missing value befor deletion---')\n",
        "print(df.isnull().sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert 'Study_Hours' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN\n",
        "df['Study_Hours'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Study_Hours'], errors='coerce')\n",
        "\n",
        "#هعوض عن القيم الفاضيه بمتوسط العمود\n",
        "df['Study_Hours']=df['Study_Hours'].fillna(df['Study_Hours'].mean())\n",
        "df['Attendance_Rate']=df['Attendance_Rate'].fillna(df['Attendance_Rate'].mean())\n",
        "\n",
        "# هتاكد ان القيم الفاضيه اتظبطت\n",
        "print('---Missing value after deletion---')\n",
        "print(df.isnull().sum())\n",
        "print('='*20)\n",
        "#عرض القيم الشاذه قبل التعديل\n",
        "print('---Outliers before adjustment---')\n",
        "print(df[df['Study_Hours']>24])\n",
        "\n",
        "#حساب الوسيط للساعات المنطقيه للمذاكره وتعديل القيم الشاذه\n",
        "median_val=df[df['Study_Hours']<=24]['Study_Hours'].median()\n",
        "df.loc[df['Study_Hours']>24,'Study_Hours']=median_val\n",
        "\n",
        "#اتاكد بعد التعديل ان القيم الشاذه اتظبطت المفروض الجدول يرجع فاضي\n",
        "print('---Outliers after adjustment---')\n",
        "print(df[df['Study_Hours']>24])"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "cu3brFbaobjt",
        "outputId": "90e40ccf-1515-44b1-e3f0-29f712ecc995"
      },
      "execution_count": 68,

            "0\n",

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "##*(3) [Model training,Regression ]"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "TSHSyFlG6XB3"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "x=df[['Study_Hours','Attendance_Rate']]\n",
        "y=df['Exam_Score']\n",
        "\n",
        "#هقسم وادرب البيانات\n",
        "x_train, x_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(x,y,test_size=0.2,random_state=42)\n",
        "#هعمل scalingلل features\n",
        "scaler=StandardScaler()\n",
        "x_train=scaler.fit_transform(x_train)\n",
        "x_test=scaler.transform(x_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "#تدريب للموديل\n",
        "model=LinearRegression()\n",
        "model.fit(x_train,y_train)\n",
        "y_pred=model.predict(x_test)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "2GdwZB046VTA"
      },
      "execution_count": 69,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "##*(4) Model Evalulation\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "mlklBigt-uyd"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "#تقيم الموديل\n",
        "mse = mean_squared_error(y_test,y_pred)\n",
        "rmse=np.sqrt(mse)\n",
        "r2=r2_score(y_test,y_pred)\n",
        "\n",
        "print('---Evaluation Metrics---')\n",
        "print(f'RMSE:{rmse:.2f}')\n",
        "print(f'R2 score:{r2:.2f}')\n",
        "print('MSE:',mse)\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "rMVVhMsT-uO4",
        "outputId": "3de68b2e-e135-456a-b18f-7e9e004c91e2"
      },
      "execution_count": 70,
      "outputs": [
        {

          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "##*(5)Visualization"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "pRCnl-aOA6Ka"
      }

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))\n",
        "plt.scatter(y_test, y_pred, color='blue', label='Actual vs Predicted')\n",
        "plt.plot([y_test.min(), y_test.max()], [y_test.min(), y_test.max()], color='red', lw=2, label='Ideal Line')\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Actual Scores')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Predicted Scores')\n",
        "plt.title('Linear Regression: Actual vs Predicted Scores')\n",

      ],
